title: Backlog, owner queue and dependency columns
goal: Columns 10, 11 and 13 show backlog freshness, what waits on the owner and version currency
acceptance: Column 10: merged PRs behind main in the backlog and reconcile due
Column 11: open findings and proposals waiting on the owner and owner steps, counts and oldest age

Column 13: key runtime and framework versions (Node, Angular) against the solution's declared targets, and consumed shared-asset versions (bricks, gauntlet-protocol pin against its latest release, harness version against the latest)
A target the manifest does not declare reads "no target declared", not current
Fixtures, committed failing first: behind main, an old owner item, a pin behind latest, a version below target
privacy: Fixtures are invented repositories, manifests and API responses; no personal data, no real alert content.
escalation: A change to how an existing table, gap kind or evidence file behaves goes back to the owner
A source that cannot be read without a new token scope or a project edit is reported unknown, never worked around

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed: freshness and owner counts exist as data; version targets are a new manifest field. Not a measurement.
